name: local-router
description: Routes each subagent to a model by task complexity, locally: heavy work to Opus, light checks to Sonnet, read-only research to Haiku. Records what each subagent then cost. No network, no server.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: act: route spawns. shadow: decide and record, change nothing. off: do nothing.

heavy_model.title: Heavy tasks
heavy_model.description: Model for build, implement, fix, refactor, design, review and plan tasks.

light_model.title: Light tasks
light_model.description: Model for validate, verify, compare, summarize and test-writing tasks.

trivial_model.title: Trivial tasks
trivial_model.description: Model for research, search, find and other read-only work.

show_toasts.title: Show a toast per routed spawn
show_toasts.description: One line to you, never to the model, each time a spawn's model is changed or refused.
